summary: Iteration 95 — Strict Visa Flow Phase B/C/D tested. Backend: 7/8 new pytest tests pass (test_visa_strict_flow_v3.py). Confirmed: (a) GET /api/visa/applications default excludes status=archived; include_archived=true returns all incl. archived. (b) DELETE /api/visa/application/{aid} soft-archives (mode=soft, status=archived) and the app disappears from default list. (c) POST .../restore brings archived app back to status=draft. (d) DELETE with hard=true permanently removes (mode=hard) — confirmed via 404 on subsequent GET. (e) POST /applications/bulk-delete with 3 application_ids soft-archives all 3 and returns mode=soft, archived=3. Empty list -> 400. (f) POST /application/{aid}/generate-letters with scope='selected_pathway' on app with business.selected_pathway_id='AU-400' returns total=7 (matches AU-400 seed of 7 required_letters). (g) Pathway list returns required_letters & required_documents populated: AU-400 = 7 letters / 12 docs (✅), AU-186 = 13 letters / 10 docs (✅). One backend test FAILS — POST /api/visa/admin/pathway upsert of required_letters/required_documents does NOT persist because /api/visa/pathways calls _ensure_seeds() on every read which unconditionally $sets the seed-defined required_letters/required_documents from pathway_overrides, clobbering any admin edit. Frontend: /visa-helper loads with all 4 tabs (AI Recommender, Applications, Manual Wizard, Admin Panel). Manual Wizard initial state shows amber 'visa-no-pathway-banner' (no selected pathway). Applications tab shows bulk-select checkboxes (visa-app-select-all + per-row), 'Show Archived' toggle, and the 'visa-bulk-archive-btn' appears as soon as ≥1 row is selected. Admin Panel renders Countries/Pathways/Letter Templates/Entities/Signatories/Bundle History sub-tabs. (AU-400 step1 button could not be clicked in this run because step1 pathway list only appears after a country card is selected — strict country→pathway gating is by design, not a bug.)

critical.issue: Admin edits to required_letters / required_documents do NOT persist. Root cause: every GET /api/visa/pathways calls _ensure_seeds() which unconditionally $sets the seed-defined required_letters and required_documents from the in-file pathway_overrides dict (visa.py lines 760-765, 786-799). Any admin upsert is overwritten on the very next read. Fix: change _PATHWAY_MACHINE_FIELDS to exclude 'required_letters' and 'required_documents' (move them to $setOnInsert), OR add an _admin_edited flag and skip $set when present, OR drop the unconditional $set for these two fields.

action_items: Fix the pathway admin upsert persistence bug: remove 'required_letters' and 'required_documents' from _PATHWAY_MACHINE_FIELDS in /app/backend/routes/visa.py (line ~782) so /pathways list doesn't clobber admin edits, or seed them via $setOnInsert only.
critical_code_review_comments: Bulk-delete endpoint correctly enforces hard-delete to super-admin only (403 otherwise) and scopes non-admin soft-delete to owner_user.
generate-letters scope='selected_pathway' correctly falls back to scope='all' when business.selected_pathway_id is absent or pathway has empty required_letters — good defensive coding.

_ensure_seeds() runs on EVERY read endpoint (countries/pathways/letter-templates/entities/signatories) which adds latency and is the root cause of the admin-upsert bug. Consider gating with a module-level _SEEDS_DONE flag or moving to a one-shot startup hook.
visa.py is now 2648 lines — strongly recommend splitting per earlier iteration suggestion (visa_admin/visa_application/visa_exports/visa_recommender).

rca of the issue: The /pathways endpoint always calls _ensure_seeds() (visa.py:889), and _ensure_seeds() unconditionally $sets the 'machine fields' tuple — which now includes 'required_letters' and 'required_documents' (line 786) — from the in-source pathway_overrides dict. So even after an admin successfully POSTs to /api/visa/admin/pathway and the DB row is updated, the very next GET /api/visa/pathways runs the seed-merge and overwrites the admin's required_letters/required_documents back to the seed values. Mitigation: remove these two fields from _PATHWAY_MACHINE_FIELDS, OR check for an admin-edited marker before applying overrides, OR seed them only via $setOnInsert.
